checkD_crosscheck_v1_hardcoded_literal_a.purpose: Tests whether run_crosscheck.py's own hardcoded 'CRC Handbook 97th ed.' literals -- never independently fetched by any prior receipt -- agree with this fire's live-harvested literature values, i.e. whether the same invented-literal failure mode found in Check-1's EEW band (refuted 2026-08-03) recurred in Check-2's density literals.

closes: Closes the last-remaining density-family coverage gap in facts.json: the 7 load-bearing resin/solvent density facts (resin.dgeba_331, resin.dgeba_828, resin.dgeba_yd128, solvent.mak, solvent.mibk, solvent.n_butanol, solvent.xylene) had zero live-fetched independent corroboration anywhere in this module's signed receipt chain; their only 'second source' was constant-crosscheck-v1's own hardcoded, unverified CRC-Handbook-97th-ed. script literals.

Also audits those hardcoded literals themselves (checkD) against genuinely independent, citation-tracked literature -- the same class of check that caught the fabricated EEW admissibility band in Check-1. All 7 hardcoded density literals agree with live-harvested literature within the 3% gate; unlike Check-1, Check-2's literals are not fabricated.
does_not_close: This is a literature re-derivation (PubChem PUG-View citation harvest), not a fresh laboratory measurement or a direct re-fetch of a physical CRC Handbook / Patty's Toxicology / Merck Index volume -- PubChem's own transcription of those references is trusted at face value.

Does not resolve which named commercial DGEBA sub-grade (dgeba_331 vs dgeba_828 vs dgeba_yd128, all compared against the same BADGE n=0 monomer literature values) the catalog's density figures most precisely represent at the oligomer-distribution level.
Gate is a point-transcription/range-containment tolerance, not a physical admissibility bound; does not establish product qualification or supplier closure.
headline: Closed the last density-family coverage gap in facts.json's load-bearing constants: the 7 resin/solvent densities whose only prior 'corroboration' was constant-crosscheck-v1's own hardcoded, never-live-fetched CRC-Handbook-97th-ed. literals. 13/13 point-value comparisons against live-harvested PubChem PUG-View literature (USCG CHRIS 1999, CRC Handbook 94th/95th ed., Patty's Toxicology 5th ed., Merck Index 13th ed.) within the 3.0% gate; 1/1 range-containment comparisons pass; 7/7 of run_crosscheck.py's own hardcoded literals independently confirmed (not fabricated, unlike Check-1's EEW band). Zero divergences found.
hypothesis: The catalog's shipped load-bearing resin/solvent density values, AND run_crosscheck.py's own hardcoded second-source literals, match live-harvested literature citations (USCG CHRIS 1999; CRC Handbook 94th/95th ed.; Patty's Toxicology 5th ed.; Merck Index 13th ed.) within a 3% gate.
non_circularity: All 7 target facts are compared against values fetched LIVE this fire (2026-08-15) from PubChem PUG-View, which attributes each value to a named, page-numbered literature citation independent of facts.json's own cited manufacturer TDS URLs and independent of run_crosscheck.py's own hardcoded literals (which cite a different Handbook edition -- 97th -- than any PubChem-harvested reference used here, and were never live-fetched by any prior receipt in this module).
purpose: Independent literature re-verification of the 7 load-bearing resin/solvent density facts whose only prior corroboration anywhere in this module is constant-crosscheck-v1's own hardcoded, never-live-fetched 'CRC Handbook 97th ed.' script literals -- the same class of unverified typed-in-script number that constant-crosscheck-v1's own Check-1 EEW band was found to fabricate (refuted 2026-08-03).

theory_reference.method: PubChem PUG-View literature-citation harvest (USCG CHRIS 1999, CRC Handbook 94th/95th ed., Patty's Toxicology 5th ed. 2001, Merck Index 13th ed. 2001), same 3.0% point-deviation gate as every prior density/EEW/AHEW receipt in this module.
